fact: In 2025 only 1,634 of 4,691 Kinshasa health facilities were integrated into DHIS2; in a facility survey 21.9% entered data digitally and directly, 43.8% used paper with delayed digital entry and 34.4% paper only.
title: Integration des systemes d'information sanitaire et efficience decisionnelle : etude empirique du DHIS2 dans la metropole de Kinshasa
publisher: Revue Internationale de la Recherche Scientifique (Revue-IRS)
